messages.text: The ledgerline service fails to start on the staging box. Check /srv/ledgerline/config/app.toml, I think the port is 8081.
I will read the config and the start log first.
[server] port = 8081 host = 0.0.0.0 [db] host = db-stg port = 5432 name = ledger pool = 12
ledgerline[2210]: fatal E_BIND 98: address already in use 0.0.0.0:8081 (held by pid 1873, nginx-proxy). ledgerline[2210]: exiting with status 3
Port 8081 is taken by the nginx-proxy process 1873, so ledgerline cannot bind. I propose moving ledgerline to another port.
Use 8093 instead of 8081, and keep the pool at 12. Do not touch nginx.
active (running) since 14:02, listening on 0.0.0.0:8093, release v2.7.4
ledgerline now runs on 8093 with the pool still at 12. nginx was not touched.
